thoughtProcess.title: Frame the physiological target
thoughtProcess.body: Use non-invasive exercise signals to estimate blood lactate, a useful proxy for metabolic stress and threshold behavior.

thoughtProcess.title: Inspect day-to-day structure
thoughtProcess.body: Treat each testing day separately first because baseline fatigue, protocol structure, and sensor behavior can shift over time.

thoughtProcess.title: Handle rest-like intervals explicitly
thoughtProcess.body: Zero power or cadence often indicates rest rather than missingness, so these rows are surfaced instead of blindly dropped.

thoughtProcess.title: Compare flexible models
thoughtProcess.body: Use ensemble regressors to capture nonlinear relationships, then layer Bayesian modeling on top to reason about repeated-measure uncertainty.
